description.text: Why this university? Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST) is a key university directly under the Ministry of Education of the P.R.China. The university, which is one of the largest in China, is distinctive among institutions of higher education. It covers a set of disciplines: philosophy, economics, law, education, literature, history, agriculture, science, engineering, medicine and management. Program Introduction The RES programme focuses on a range of economic issues in China. Emphasis is on timely, policy-related research that is of use to decision-makers as well as researchers from the region and beyond. FeeStructure 1.Tuition Fee: 38000 RMB/year 2.Accommodation Fee: Please click here to see details 3.Living Cost:15000~20000 RMB/year 4.Insurance: 600 RMB/year 5.Others(books,deposit): 2000 RMB/year Internship Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, visits to companies, and career consultation. Duration:2 Years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree of Economics in Quantitative Economics by Huazhong University of Science and Technology. Future Career The graduates can work in the International trade transportation, insurance, customs clearance etc agencies, specialized foreign-trade corporations, and import and export department's of foreign-owned enterprises.

duration.text: The Regional Economics at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5277 USD/per year ￥ 38000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
